comparison.objective: Move two locked paper guides snugly against an A4 stack without disturbing it.
comparison.physical_skill: Squeeze each release tab while sliding its guide, then release it to lock.
comparison.success_condition: Both guides are snug and locked, stack unmoved, and robot released.
comparison.reason: It tests squeeze-slide-lock coordination and compliant positioning, not impact-energy regulation, notch fracture, insert retention, or fragment containment.
